review: B08 S05/S06 iPhone native visual review
test_result: 3 requested, 3 executed, 3 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped in phone retry 1
observations: Normal manual release list and feature detail show the current version, category, title, summary, preserved icon, and navigation without visible overlap.

At maximum accessibility text size, the version label and 0.8.0 occupy separate rows; the full introductory copy and iOS 27 Support row title and summary are represented in AX and visually flow vertically.
At maximum accessibility text size, the detail category, title, full summary, and version badge flow vertically without observed overlap; the automatic release modal retains a visible Done button.

The repeated title inside the detail hero artwork is visually ellipsized at MAX. Hero artwork source was unchanged by this app diff and the main title is fully visible; this is not classified as an introduced layout finding.
limits: Only one iPhone light English normal/MAX sample and the named states were inspected; no dark mode or other language inference.
iPad SDK evidence was still pending at review time; no current Duo capture or validation.
The screenshots show the top viewport. AX contains offscreen row content; the passed native selectors support navigation and Done behavior but do not establish every release row visually.
